title: feat(nm2sreadx): neighbor-read of 1-in 2-out split at t+1 on two-axis opposite x-probes: reverse fails, face fails
science: opposite seed, x-probes, unsigned neighbour-read at t+1. A and D never form a 1-in-2-out split (M={-e_3}, O={+e_1}: cover misses e_2), so both pair-reads fail regardless of the letter. Recomputed exactly.
